title: Implement off claude: the two-step Plan
description:
Per the map ticket 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, Implement: two Plan paths).

On an App other than claude (codex now; the four Apps of Ticket 22 later) Implement plans in two steps: the session writes <Run directory>/plan.md and a Stage result 'STATUS: plan', then waits. The Orchestrator reads STATUS: plan as a Plan ready (no dialog, no hook), and the plan Judgment or the Plan Question acts as today (Ticket 5's modal). Feedback goes into the pane as a prompt, and the session revises plan.md and writes STATUS: plan again. On approval the Harness sends 'implement the approved plan' and the session carries on to STATUS: done. A worktree changed before approval (HEAD moved or a dirty tree) fails the Plan, as a plan failure does today (Ask::PlanFailed, the user's alone). claude keeps its native plan mode and ExitPlanMode hook. stage-implement gets both paths; an Input tells the session which (Plan: native plan mode / Plan: write plan.md and STATUS: plan). The plan/implement split stays claude-only. Lift Ticket 7's refusal of Implement off claude.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world with Implement on codex: STATUS: plan raises a plan Judgment; at or above PLAN_FLOOR the prompt 'implement the approved plan' is sent; below it, the Plan Question; feedback is sent as a prompt and the next STATUS: plan is judged again; a worktree changed before approval fails the Plan; the codex argv has no plan mode or --settings; the result parser takes STATUS: plan.
